_comment: Fargate task definition for the release-slice rescan (scripts/rescan_release.py). Image pinned BY DIGEST to the build of commit d9a1da7 (tag rescan-d9a1da7: Trivy fail-loud fix + rescan tool). Pulls the release results from S3 read-only, rescans every corpus input and every game with network access (as the run had), captures Trivy's module cache + checks bundle, and syncs the report to <results>_rescan/ (progress every SYNC_INTERVAL seconds). Never writes to the release results prefix.

containerDefinitions.name: rescan
command: set -u; echo "[rescan] start $(date -u +%FT%TZ) commit=$TERRAREPAIR_GIT_COMMIT src=$RESULTS_S3_URI out=$OUT_S3_URI"; aws s3 sync "$RESULTS_S3_URI" /app/rel --exclude '_smoke/*' --only-show-errors || { echo '[rescan] FATAL: could not pull results'; exit 2; }; echo "[rescan] pulled $(ls /app/rel/games/*.json | wc -l) game files"; mkdir -p /app/rescan_out; ( while true; do sleep "$SYNC_INTERVAL"; aws s3 sync /app/rescan_out "$OUT_S3_URI" --exclude '*.tar.gz' --only-show-errors; done ) & SP=$!; python3 scripts/rescan_release.py --results /app/rel --out /app/rescan_out --capture; RC=$?; kill $SP 2>/dev/null; echo "[rescan] rescan_release.py exit=$RC"; aws s3 sync /app/rescan_out "$OUT_S3_URI" --only-show-errors; echo "[rescan] end $(date -u +%FT%TZ)"; exit $RC
